text:
noah: FYI rolled a small experiment at 12:13 PT: sequence-aware micro-batching + early-ack cache priming on the us-west cluster (5% traffic).

deploy-bot: deploy release/seq-microbatch-early-priming -> canary-us-west completed (id: dpl_20260324_05)

noah: tl;dr: short prompt median latency from ~175ms -> ~105ms, 95th from ~420ms -> ~260ms. embedding-only routes show ~12% lower GPU-seconds per 1k tokens. overall cost estimate -15% for the slice.

lina: great numbers. how are we measuring cost? is that extrapolated from billing or realtime vm metrics?

noah: perf-bot sampled 3k requests and combined token counts with GPU utilization traces. also cross-checked with recent billing window for sanity. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/seqbatch/summary

omar: any increase in retries or error rates? micro-batching sometimes causes transient head-of-line problems.

henry: watch the queue length metrics. if we see queues > 150ms behind, we should throttle the micro-batcher. currently queue p95 is flat.

noah: right — we added an early-ack path so cache priming happens without delaying client-facing ack. that decouples warmup and avoids head-of-line for tiny requests.

perf-bot: metric snapshot: request_count=3021, cache_primed=1325, priming_latency_avg=18ms, batch_size_median=3, p50_latency_down=70ms, p95_latency_down=160ms

lina: curious about long-context model impact. if we prime too aggressively could we evict helpful KV entries?

noah: tested on 8k context, eviction metric unchanged. priming uses soft affinity so we avoid thrashing. long-context p50 unchanged, p95 +8ms in worst slices.

omar: what's the rollout plan if canary looks good?

noah: ramp to 25% in 45m, monitor 30m windows. target 100% in ~4 hours if stable. key checks: cache_hit_rate, batch_size_distribution, gpu_util, retry_rate, and p99 latency.

henry: add GC pause and mem fragmentation dashboards too. micro-batching changes affected alloc patterns in prior run.

ops-bot: @oncall notified: "Seq-aware microbatch + early-ack priming canary live (5%). Monitoring rules attached."

lina: can we get a short blurb for the weekly product update? customers will ask about "lower latency" claims. a single sentence + numbers should be fine.

noah: wrote a short line in the release notes draft and flagged product for the console banner: "Sequence-aware micro-batching + cache priming reduced short-prompt median latency by ~40% in early trials".

omar: any flags for Dedicated/private infra? should we gate this behind a config toggle?

noah: infra-controlled toggle for now. plan is an Optimize recommendation later.

lina: bravo team. ping this thread with any anomalies. I'll grab the long-run benchmark later tonight against steady traffic.

noah: thanks all :rocket:
